column1: # Per-skill size ceilings (bytes of SKILL.md). Enforced by scripts/check-skill-health.ts
# (bun run check:skill-health, in verify and scripts/skills-commit-gate.sh).
# A skill with no row is capped at 16384 bytes. Rows exist only for skills over that cap.
# A ceiling is today's size plus 10% headroom; it only goes down without a reviewer-visible edit.
# After a diet, set last_diet to the new size and the ceiling to that size plus 10%;
# a skill more than 10% over its last diet gets a diet, not another paragraph (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Changing a skill").
